description: ONE CALL, ONE STATE, EVERY LANGUAGE A PROJECTION across all 97 supported languages (9 RTL chiral w2=-1). Pass target_langs (or ["*"] / ["*97"]) to seal the texts state once and receive one projection per language under projections; pass target_lang alone for a single projection receipt (status RENDERED, PARTIAL, or REFUSED_*). Exact integer symmetric Dice association, positional alignment, productive morphology, closed-class concord, and J_Z scalar conservation; zero models, zero floats.

source_lang.description: ISO 639 source language code; required, auto refused, e.g. en

target_lang.description: Exactly one of target_lang or target_langs: single target ISO language code across the 97-language chart, e.g. es

target_langs.description: Exactly one of target_lang or target_langs: array of ISO language codes or ["*"] / ["*97"] for all 97 languages

text.description: One source text to render, e.g. Book

texts.description: Up to 64 source texts rendered in order

name: affine_translate_text
